english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a device used to weigh people or things.

examples.english: This scale is out of battery.

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the pound as a unit of weight, including the standard 16-ounce pound.

examples.english: I bought a pound of rice.
